# Python Template

A template for Python projects.

> [!TIP]
>
> If you wanna develop:
>
> - GraphQL API, go for [strawberry](https://github.com/strawberry-graphql/strawberry).
>   - As for ODM you can use [SQLAlchemy](https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy), [piccolo](https://github.com/piccolo-orm/piccolo), or [Tortoise ORM](https://github.com/tortoise/tortoise-orm/).
>   - As for ODM [Beanie](https://github.com/BeanieODM/beanie) is a solid choice.
> - RESTful API, use [litestar](https://github.com/litestar-org/litestar).
>   - As for ODM [Beanie](https://github.com/BeanieODM/beanie) is a solid choice.

## Usage

```shell
make init
make start
```

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for the project layout and conventions.
